notes: Reference manifest for Robinhood Chain 4663, launch.open kind univ4_hook, pairWith eth (native ETH, currency 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000, always currency0; IDM is currency1). Recheck launch.open capabilities for 4663 at submission. Name and ticker finalized by owner: Intelligent Dance Market (IDM). Build from contracts/; resolve $poolManager, predicted $token and $factory for the selected LaunchFactory. Mine exact hook flags 0x3040 with the final constructor arguments and the factory CREATE2 deployer. The constructor makes no external calls. Factory-only initialization binds exactly one sorted IDM/ETH pool at fee 12500 and tickSpacing 60. afterInitialize seeds SPEC section 3 state; afterSwap reads the actual BalanceDelta (|ETH delta| drives the rules) and the post-swap tick, mutates two packed words and emits Mutated/Movement/Drop/Accumulated/TrackComplete. No owner, admin, fees, return deltas, payable/receive or fund handling in the hook. hat/glitch/snare thresholds are ETH wei from contracts/src/QuoteCalibration.sol (0.00125/0.0125/0.0625 ETH, kept in the ABI; v2 classifies relative to the size EMA). The whale threshold is not an argument: K*sqrt(FDV) from the post-swap tick, clamped to 0.005..50 ETH (whaleThreshold()). Opening price: set by the launch policy. Precedent: launch #2124 (Ethereum, univ4_hook, pairWith eth) opened at tick 184200, FDV ~10 ETH, which gives a whale threshold of ~0.063 ETH at launch. The fixed-supply token mints 1e27 units once to its deployer; the factory performs all allocations and single-sided seeding. No transaction has been broadcast; a chain-fork factory rehearsal remains a launch-stage requirement. Preserve SPEC.md, vectors and ABI bit-for-bit. Gas: contracts/GAS.md.
